description: Hardened Cloudflare WAF, Rate Limiting, and Firewall rules for production applications.

rules.name: Block Malicious Bots & Threat Scores
rules.expression: (cf.threat_score gt 20) or (cf.bot_management.score lt 20 and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot)
rules.description: Challenges suspicious traffic, automated headless scrapers, and known bad IPs.

rules.name: Block Obvious Honeypot & Reconnaissance Paths
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/phpmyadmin") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.git") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-login.php")
rules.description: Instantly drops connections scanning for common admin panels, git metadata, and environment files.

rules.name: Rate Limit Authentication Endpoints
rules.description: Restricts login attempts to 5 per minute per IP, blocking for 15 minutes upon violation.
